summary: Repaired the release publisher on node1. Publication now validates MANIFEST and atomically replaces the current symlink, with release two live after successful reboot recovery.
actions_performed: Replaced the delete/sleep/link sequence with a same-filesystem temporary symlink and atomic rename.
Added argument, directory, and MANIFEST validation.
Verified 16,000 concurrent reads during 200 publication cycles.
Verified rejection preserves current and rollback works to both complete releases without modifying staged files.
Rebooted node1 and verified changed boot identity, preserved OS/kernel, publisher, releases, and functionality.

evidence.requirement: Atomic publication with current continuously present and complete
evidence.summary: Final script uses `mv -Tf` for atomic replacement; 16,000 concurrent checks passed during 200 one-to-two publication cycles.

evidence.requirement: Refuse releases missing MANIFEST and retain previous current target
evidence.summary: The incomplete release returned failure before and after reboot while current remained unchanged.

evidence.requirement: Preserve staged releases and allow rollback to either complete release
evidence.summary: Publishing to release one and back to release two succeeded; staged-file hashes were unchanged.

evidence.requirement: Keep the installed legacy OS release and kernel
evidence.summary: Ubuntu 7.10 and kernel 2.6.22-14-generic were unchanged across the repair and reboot.
Captured healthy baseline boot ID, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, and direct post-restart publisher/data recovery with functional rejection and rollback tests.
